memorialDuration.question: Har yaushe shafin tunawa zai kasance yana aiki?
memorialDuration.answer: Shafin tunawarku zai kasance yana aiki har abada. Mun himmatu wajen adana waɗannan gadon dijital ba tare da iyakancewa ba, muna tabbatar da cewa tsararraki masu zuwa za su iya tunawa da kuma yin bikin rayuwar masoyansu koyaushe.

contentTypes.question: Wane irin abun ciki zan iya ƙarawa a shafin tunawa?
contentTypes.answer: Kuna iya ƙara hotuna, bidiyoyi, abubuwan tunawa da aka rubuta, rikodin sauti, da muhimman lokuta na rayuwa. Dandalinmu yana tallafawa nau'ikan kafofin watsa labarai daban-daban don taimaka muku ƙirƙirar girmamawa mai ma'ana da cikakke.

privacyControl.question: Shin zan iya sarrafa wanda zai iya ganin shafin tunawa?
privacyControl.answer: Eh, kuna da cikakken iko kan saitunan sirri. Kuna iya sanya shafin ya zama na jama'a, na sirri tare da kariya ta kalmar sirri, ko raba shi kawai tare da takamaiman mutane ta hanyar hanyoyin gayyata.

multipleContributors.question: Shin mutane da yawa za su iya ba da gudummawa ga shafin tunawa ɗaya?
multipleContributors.answer: Tabbas. Kuna iya gayyatar 'yan uwa da abokai don ba da gudummawar abubuwan tunawarsu, hotuna, da labaransu. Wannan yana haifar da sararin haɗin gwiwa inda kowa zai iya raba ra'ayinsa na musamman da abubuwan tunawa.

changesAfterCreation.question: Zan iya yin canje-canje ga shafin tunawa bayan an ƙirƙira shi?
changesAfterCreation.answer: Eh, kuna iya sabuntawa da gyara shafin tunawa a kowane lokaci. Ƙara sabon abun ciki, gyara bayanan da ke akwai, ko sabunta saitunan sirri a duk lokacin da ake buƙata.

cost.question: Shin akwai farashi mai alaƙa da ƙirƙirar shafin tunawa?
cost.answer: Muna ba da zaɓuɓɓuka na kyauta da na musamman. Sigar kyauta ta haɗa da mahimman abubuwa, yayin da zaɓuɓɓuka na musamman ke ba da ƙarin ajiya, babban gyare-gyare, da ingantaccen ikon sirri. Burinmu shine sanya tunawar dijital ta zama mai sauƙi ga kowa.

termsAndConditions.title: Memorial Website Service Terms and Conditions

serviceDescription.title: 1. Service Description
serviceDescription.content: Our memorial website service provides a platform to create and maintain online memorials for loved ones. This includes hosting, templates, and maintenance as specified in your chosen plan.

paymentTerms.title: 2. Payment Terms
paymentTerms.content: All payments are one-time fees for the selected plan. Payment is required before service activation. Fees are non-refundable once the website has been created and published.

contentGuidelines.title: 3. Content Guidelines
contentGuidelines.content: You agree to provide appropriate content that respects the memory of the deceased. We reserve the right to remove any content that violates our community guidelines or is deemed inappropriate.

privacyAndData.title: 4. Privacy and Data
privacyAndData.content: We respect your privacy and will handle all personal information in accordance with our privacy policy. Memorial content may be publicly accessible unless privacy settings are applied.

serviceAvailability.title: 5. Service Availability
serviceAvailability.content: We strive to maintain 99% uptime but cannot guarantee uninterrupted service. Scheduled maintenance may occur with prior notice.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: You retain rights to the content you provide. We retain rights to the platform, templates, and technology. The memorial website design is licensed for your use.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.content: You may request termination of service at any time. We reserve the right to terminate service for violation of terms. Memorial websites are maintained for the duration specified in your plan.

limitationOfLiability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.content: Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the service. We are not liable for indirect damages or losses resulting from service use.

termsAndConditions.note: Note: By checking the agreement box, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.
